milestones.name: Obtain Vengeful Spirit Spell
milestones.note: Granted by the Snail Shaman inside the Ancestral Mound

milestones.name: Defeat Elder Baldur (Ancestral Mound gate)
milestones.note: Killing the Elder Baldur inside the Ancestral Mound opens the locked gate behind which the Knight awakens

milestones.name: Defeat Elder Baldur (Greenpath entrance)
milestones.note: Killing the Elder Baldur guarding the entrance unlocks access to Greenpath

milestones.name: Enter Greenpath
milestones.note: Accessible after defeating the Elder Baldur at its entrance

milestones.name: Save Zote in Greenpath
milestones.note: Knight can choose to save Zote from a Vengefly King along the path to Greenpath; must be done before acquiring the Mantis Claw or Zote dies

milestones.name: Zote appears in Dirtmouth
milestones.note: Occurs after Zote is saved in Greenpath

milestones.name: Acquire Love Key
milestones.note: Found in Queen's Gardens; opens the door inside the Tower of Love to fight the Collector

milestones.name: Defeat Zote (Colosseum of Fools)
milestones.note: Final boss of the first trial; grants the Rivalry achievement. Requires saving Zote in both Greenpath and Deepnest

zones.name: Ancestral Mound
zones.fingerprintHint: Snail shaman mound constructed from bones and shells; contains the Snail Shaman and a locked gate opened by killing the Elder Baldur

zones.name: Forgotten Crossroads
zones.fingerprintHint: Hub area connecting to Ancestral Mound and path to Greenpath

zones.name: Greenpath
zones.fingerprintHint: Accessed after defeating Elder Baldur at its entrance; Zote is found trapped by a Vengefly King here

zones.name: Dirtmouth
zones.fingerprintHint: Town area where Zote appears after being saved in Greenpath

zones.name: City of Tears
zones.fingerprintHint: Zote found in a corridor leading to its storerooms

zones.name: Deepnest
zones.fingerprintHint: Zote found stuck in spider webs, captured by the beasts of Deepnest

zones.name: Colosseum of Fools
zones.fingerprintHint: Zote found in the resting area and becomes final boss of the first trial

zones.name: Queen's Gardens
zones.fingerprintHint: Source location of the Love Key

zones.name: Tower of Love
zones.fingerprintHint: Door unlocked by the Love Key; the Collector is fought inside

abilities.name: Vengeful Spirit
abilities.note: Granted by the Snail Shaman; after obtaining it the Knight falls unconscious and awakens behind a locked gate

abilities.name: Love Key
abilities.grants: Unlocks door of Tower of Love
abilities.note: Covered in padding, bears a symbol of love; opens the door where the Collector can be fought

bosses.name: Snail Shaman
bosses.note: Grants the Vengeful Spirit Spell to the Knight

bosses.name: Elder Baldur
bosses.note: Killing it opens the locked gate inside the Ancestral Mound

bosses.name: Elder Baldur
bosses.note: Killing it allows access to Greenpath

bosses.name: Vengefly King
bosses.note: Holds Zote in its mandibles; Knight can choose to save or abandon Zote

bosses.name: Zote
bosses.note: Final boss of the first trial; deals no damage due to shellwood nail; beating him grants the Rivalry achievement
